neighbours.label: eating-out venues and their food: restaurant, café or burger-place talk (lunch spot, menu items such as burgers and tacos, a café's opening hours), in English and Russian; the same words about a non-food place stay quieter
fire: After the museum we wandered around looking for a decent dinner place that was still serving.
The bistro on the corner does a fine steak sandwich and very good fries.
Locals told us the best noodle bar in town is the tiny one behind the station.
Their brunch menu has pancakes, omelettes and a huge breakfast burrito.
The pizzeria closes its kitchen at ten, so book a table early.
В этом кафе готовят вкусные бургеры и неплохую пиццу.
We found a cosy little diner that serves pie and coffee all night.
The waiter recommended the grilled fish and brought us a basket of bread.
quiet: After the museum we wandered around looking for a decent parking place that was still free.
The shop on the corner does fine shoe repairs and very good key cutting.
Locals told us the best bookshop in town is the tiny one behind the station.
Their spring catalogue has tents, sleeping bags and a huge folding canoe.
The pharmacy closes its doors at ten, so pick up the medicine early.
В этом магазине продают хорошие книги и недорогие тетради.
We found a cosy little cabin that has a stove and a view of the lake.
The guide recommended the northern trail and brought us a map of the valley.
